meta.title: Vietnam Travel Guide 2026 for Indians | Visa, Best Time, 9-Day Plan
meta.description:
Planning a Vietnam trip from India in 2026? This 10-minute guide covers everything: the best time to visit, how to get the Vietnam e-visa, where to go (Hanoi, Ha Long Bay, Ninh Binh, Sapa, Hoi An, Da Nang, Phong Nha, Saigon, Mekong Delta, Phu Quoc), where to stay, what to eat, how to get around, money and SIM tips, a simple 9-day itinerary and the 3 mistakes most first-timers make.

Want us to plan it? WhatsApp Trust and Trip and type VIETNAM: https://wa.me/918115999588?text=VIETNAM
Website: https://trustandtrip.com

QUICK ANSWERS
- Do Indians need a visa for Vietnam? Yes. Apply online for the Vietnam e-visa, only on the official government portal (evisa.gov.vn). Apply at least 2 weeks before you fly.
- Best time to visit Vietnam? It depends on the region. North (Hanoi, Ha Long): Oct-Apr. Centre (Hoi An, Da Nang): Feb-Aug. South (Saigon, Phu Quoc): Dec-Apr.
- How many days for Vietnam? 9 days covers Hanoi, Ha Long Bay, Hoi An and Saigon without rushing.
- How far is Vietnam from India? Direct flights from Delhi, Mumbai and Kolkata take about 4-6 hours.
